Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified "nucleus, cell wall, cell membrane" (Option C) as the answer. This mistake occurred because the Planner misunderstood the biological concept of common structures in plant and animal cells. While the cell membrane and nucleus are indeed common to both, the cell wall is exclusive to plant cells and some other organisms (e.g., fungi, bacteria) but is not present in animal cells. The Planner also incorrectly equated the extracellular matrix/glycocalyx of animal cells to a cell wall, which is biologically inaccurate. This conceptual error led to the selection of the wrong answer.
